tests.name: json_pointer_leading_zero
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment using a json pointer with a leading zero token on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_empty_token
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment using an empty json pointer token on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_valid_array_index_zero
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment using token '0' which is a valid array index on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_valid_array_index_nonzero
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment using a multi-digit valid array index without a leading zero.

tests.name: json_pointer_dash_token
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment using the dash token '-' on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_alpha_token
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment using an alphabetical object key token on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_nested_leading_zero
tests.intent: Probes nested operator[] assignment where an intermediate level uses a token with a leading zero.

tests.name: json_pointer_existing_array_leading_zero
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment using a leading zero token on an existing array value.

tests.name: json_pointer_plus_prefix
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment with a token starting with a plus sign on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_minus_prefix
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment with a token starting with a minus sign on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_space_prefix
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment with a token having a leading space on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_alpha_suffix
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment with a token containing digits and letters on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_unflatten_comparison
tests.intent: Probes unflatten behavior on a JSON object containing a leading zero key.

tests.name: json_pointer_contains_leading_zero
tests.intent: Probes contains method with a leading zero token on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_multiple_zeros
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment with a token consisting of multiple zeros on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_single_digit_nine
tests.intent: Probes operator[] assignment with token '9' on a null value.

tests.name: json_pointer_empty_string_explicit
tests.intent: Probes operator[] lookup with an explicitly constructed empty string json pointer.

tests.name: json_pointer_slash_only
tests.intent: Probes operator[] lookup using a json pointer with only a slash character.

tests.name: json_pointer_deep_leading_zero
tests.intent: Probes deep operator[] traversal where a leading zero token is at the leaf level.

tests.name: json_pointer_ordered_json_leading_zero
tests.intent: Probes ordered_json operator[] assignment with a leading zero token on a null value.
